evals.prompt: I shot at 25fps under 50Hz fluorescent light with 1/60 shutter and see flicker. Why and fix?
evals.expected: 1/60 is not a multiple of 1/100 s light pulses in 50Hz regions; use 1/50 (180deg at 25fps) or 1/100; mention flicker-free LEDs / deflicker in post.
